name: 48168 · Northville, MI
findings: ZIP 48168 (Northville) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48168 (Northville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48168 (Northville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 53 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
